title: Borderline Personality Disorder: Symptoms, Causes, BPD vs Bipolar and Getting Help in India
seoDescription: BPD symptoms include intense mood swings, fear of abandonment and impulsivity. Know the causes, how it differs from bipolar and where to get help in India.
excerpt: The four symptom areas of BPD, what raises the risk, a side-by-side table with bipolar disorder, why therapies like DBT work, and how to get assessed in India through a psychiatrist, psychologist or Tele-MANAS.
